title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.26199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. translated_title: 通过自适应数据选择学习忠实地用图像思考
translated_abstract: 用图像思考能够使视觉语言模型通过主动裁剪并放大细粒度视觉细节来克服感知瓶颈，有望同时带来更高的准确率以及可解释的、基于区域的推理。然而，我们的分析表明，这类模型准确率的提升并不能保证忠实的工具使用；它们经常在并未真正依赖放大区域的情况下调用工具，从而削弱了工具辅助推理的可靠性。我们将这种不忠实行为追溯到训练数据：当问题无需放大即可回答时，模型可以在忽略返回证据的情况下答对，且随着训练过程中模型在无工具条件下回答能力的提升，这一问题会进一步加剧。为了在整个训练过程中保持缩放操作的有效性，我们将训练数据适配到模型不断演进的能力上，在那些正确的放大证据仍能帮助模型回答的问题上进行训练。
tldr: 该论文揭示了“用图像思考”模型普遍存在不忠实的工具调用现象（即答对却并不真正依赖放大后的区域），并提出自适应数据选择方法，使训练数据随模型能力动态调整、聚焦于放大证据真正有效的问题，从而实现忠实的基于图像的推理。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies unfaithful tool use in Thinking-with-Images models (correct answers that ignore zoomed evidence) and proposes adaptive data selection that curates training questions to the model's evolving capability, keeping zoomed evidence genuinely useful to enable faithful visual reasoning.
